title: Surprised I found this sub
content: I’m not sure how I stumbled upon this, but I’ve had a handful of dreams where I am inside my local mall.. One of my dreams first started off with me being in a desert with 3 other captives on our knees, which we were each executed 1 by 1 with the gun pointed directly at our faces. This is also the first time I’ve ever been “killed” in my dream. However, I didn’t wake up IRL. I woke up on the 2nd floor of the mall, wondering if this is the afterlife. People were just walking slowly or sitting against the glass railing looking at the ground. I start to walk to another part of the mall, which I have seen in previous dreams. This part of the mall is open to the outside on 2nd/3rd floor like an open atrium. There is a big jump pad that shoots people across the city around 5 blocks away into the roof of my old condo building I used to live in when I was in high school. I’ve also hid on this roof in my dream, which seemed like a watchtower on the 24th floor. I don’t remember the other details, this dream was probably around 8-10 years ago. Hope you enjoyed 😋
